items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: John Vanmore used to come around to see her all the time.

ctx.x: Yeah. I keep my eye on the ladies, you know. My first one she was a real lady. She was a doll. And as I say this woman, it was either her or the one with the one eye. What was the one that had the one eye? What was her name, Hop? Anyhow, so she walked over the stage, you know, went down, the show was over, the Club DeLisa you know, so here comes the strolling singer and this woman. And she walked up to him and she started right away. [sings] I’m going to lock my car and throw away the key, I’m tired of you…
John Vanmore used to come around to see her all the time.
Yeah. Chippy. Chippy. Yeah, Chippy, Chippy.
